newsitem.title: UK: Tunstall Group marked down on weak results.
newsitem.headline: Tunstall Group marked down on weak results.

text.p: Shares in British alarm and emergency communication systems firm Tunstall Group were marked down on Thursday after weaker-than-expected full year results were released.
At 1150 GMT the share price was quoted at 261p -- down 32-1/2p -- but no stock had been traded.
Tunstall's preliminary results statement for the year to September 30 showed pre-tax profits static at 8.2 million stg while turnover increased to 78.0 million stg from 60.7 million.
The figures disappointed analysts who had forecast pre-tax profits of 8.4 million stg on average.
Tunstall chairman Michael Dawson blamed lacklustre performance on anticipated orders not materialising and a lapse in control of overheads and margins which, he said, had now been rectified.
